subject: Databases
text: Consider the following relational schema: Students (rollno: integer, name: string, age: integer, cgpa: real) Courses (courseno: integer, cname: string, credits: integer) Enrolled (rollno: integer, courseno: integer, grade: string) Which of the following options is/are correct SQL query/queries to retrieve the names of the students enrolled in course number (i.e., courseno) 1470?
options: SELECT S.name FROM Students S WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM Enrolled E WHERE E.courseno = 1470 AND E.rollno = S.rollno);
SELECT S.name FROM Students S WHERE SIZEOF (SELECT * FROM Enrolled E WHERE E.courseno = 1470 AND E.rollno = S.rollno) > 0;
